messages:
mira (Partnerships): 🎉 Quick update — Quantave has agreed to publish Redwood Private as an OpenShift Operator on Red Hat Marketplace. Pilot customer is FirstBank; onboarding kickoff scheduled for 2026-04-05. Huge thanks to Henry, Jordan, and the SEs for getting the operator over the finish line.
henry (Eng): Nice! Operator v0.9 built and passed e2e in staging this morning. CI report: https://ci.internal/redwood/operators/quantave-operator/12345 :white_check_mark:
jordan (PM): This is great — one-click private installs for OpenShift customers. Marketing + Sales: we should prep a short deployment checklist, an ops README for KMS/HSM, and a blurb for PCI/SOC requirements.
alex (Marketing): On it. I'll draft a launch blog and a joint case study template. Can we get an embargoed quote from FirstBank after their onboarding call on 2026-04-06? @quantave-cs
quantave-cs: Yep — we'll coordinate with FirstBank and pull a short performance snippet (latency/throughput and infra footprint) for the case study.
sam (Sales): Quick commercial q: is this a joint listing or a reseller/OEM arrangement? Need to update the sales playbook + pricing cards before we go public.
mira (Partnerships): It's a joint ISV listing — Redwood Private packaged as an OpenShift Operator, with Quantave shipping our connector bundle in their tile. Revenue & support split per the partner SOW; details in the partner doc (internal): https://redwood.app/partner/quantave-deal 
ops-bot: build 2026.3.14-quantave-operator deployed to staging — status: SUCCESS. Logs: tail -n 50 /var/log/operator/2026-03-14.log
henry (Eng): Small follow-up: we need a one-page README in the Helm chart for KMS/HSM integration steps and an example manifests snippet for companies using HSM-backed keys. I'll open the PR today (link will be in the repo).
alex (Marketing): Calendar plan: blog draft by 2026-03-20, joint case study ready end of April, Red Hat Marketplace listing targeted for early May. Will prepare an internal one-pager for Sales ops. cc: @here :tada:
mira (Partnerships): Amazing work — this helps our Private adoption in regulated accounts a lot. quick shoutout to Henry, Jordan, and the solutions team. :raised_hands:
